product_metadata.title: SONGMICS Velvet Hangers, Set of 30 Clothes Hanger with Rose Gold Swivel Hook, Non-Slip, and Space-Saving, 0.2-Inch Thick, 17.1-Inch Long for Coat, Shirt, Dress, Pants, Tie, White UCRF021W01
features: [No More Slipping] The non-slip velvet surface of these hangers prevents your clothes from falling to the ground, piling up, and getting wrinkled; the notches are great for hanging clothes with straps like camisoles

[Slim yet Sturdy] Made of durable ABS plastic, these clothes hangers are slim but very strong; each coat hanger has a max. static load capacity of 11 lb, so even heavy winter coats can be hung without problems
[Save Wardrobe Space] With a slim profile, these velvet hangers are space-saving so you can hang more clothes in the same wardrobe; the central bar is perfect for ties or scarves
[Rose Gold Hooks] The shiny rose gold hooks rotate 360°, helping you hang your clothes neatly while adding a little sparkle to your closet
[What You Get] A set of 30 high-quality velvet clothes hangers with shiny rose gold hooks that are strong and difficult to break, and a better way to organize your wardrobe
